scripts.build:generic: npx mjml generic/generic.mjml -o generic/generic.html --config.allowIncludes true --config.includePath . --config.minify true
scripts.build:contact-en: npx mjml contact/contact-en.mjml -o contact/contact-en.html --config.allowIncludes true --config.includePath . --config.minify true
scripts.build:contact-pt: npx mjml contact/contact-pt.mjml -o contact/contact-pt.html --config.allowIncludes true --config.includePath . --config.minify true
scripts.build:contact-reply-en: npx mjml contact/contact-reply-en.mjml -o contact/contact-reply-en.html --config.allowIncludes true --config.includePath . --config.minify true
scripts.build:contact-reply-pt: npx mjml contact/contact-reply-pt.mjml -o contact/contact-reply-pt.html --config.allowIncludes true --config.includePath . --config.minify true
scripts.build:brevo: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),{execSync}=require('child_process');for(const d of fs.readdirSync('brevo',{withFileTypes:true})){if(!d.isDirectory()||d.name[0]==='_')continue;for(const f of fs.readdirSync('brevo/'+d.name)){if(!f.endsWith('.mjml'))continue;const p='brevo/'+d.name+'/'+f;console.log(p);execSync('npx mjml '+p+' -o '+p.replace(/mjml$/,'html')+' --config.allowIncludes true --config.includePath . --config.minify true --config.keepComments false',{stdio:'inherit'})}}"
scripts.build: npm run build:generic && npm run build:contact-en && npm run build:contact-pt && npm run build:contact-reply-en && npm run build:contact-reply-pt
